title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1969-11-07
source: MR > DAT > CD > EAC > CDWAV > Cool Edit Pro Noise Filter > SHN > CDR (Except for * which is MR > DAT > CD)

ai_review.summary: Decent recording of a late‑1969 show with a cosmic Dark Star > Unbroken Chain jam and a soaring Lovelight ending, delivering high energy despite some tightness.
ai_review.review: The concert is praised for its powerful second‑half improvisations – the Dark Star/Unbroken Chain segment is described as jaw‑dropping and the closing Lovelight jam shines. Recording quality is noted as merely “not a bad” capture, implying it’s listenable but not pristine. A few critics point out a more polished, sometimes overly tight feel in songs like Mama Tried, but overall the performance is celebrated.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers highlight outstanding musical moments and give high star scores; recording comments are modestly positive, leading to a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as "not a bad" recording – clear enough for enjoyment with no major flaws mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Mix of high‑energy improvisations and tighter, more professional arrangements typical of the November ’69 period.

band_member_comments.Bob: Commented on Bob Weir spacing the second verse of "Mama Tried," indicating a more polished but occasionally overly tight delivery.
